text: sync: cap rows per batch + chunk on clients; one large /sync 500s all writes instance-wide

Done in fe527d5. Server: sync.MAX_CHANGES_PER_SYNC=250 (~78ms/batch), enforced in apply_changes before any row is applied; 422 too_many_changes carries max_changes and deliberately NO row_id so clients chunk rather than quarantine. sqlite3.OperationalError now maps to 503 server_busy + Retry-After (contention only; other OperationalErrors re-raise so a real fault still fails loudly). Clients: web splitChanges() in useSync.ts packs lists first and sends full_lists on the last batch only; Android takes one batch per pass and recurses, guarded on the backlog having actually shrunk so a row the server never echoes back cannot spin forever. Note 250 is well above your >=50 floor: 50 would have meant many more round trips on a large backlog for no extra safety.
